channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Over 150 clubs awarded in Ulster GAA Club Infrastructure Development Grant
item.description: One hundred and fifty-two clubs from across the province have been awarded a total of €857,923 of funding through Ulster GAA's 2025 Club Infrastructure Development Grant scheme.

item.title: Ballygunner to the fore as Hurling Club Championship Team of the Year named
item.description: The GAA have announced the AIB GAA Hurling Club Championship Team of the Year.

item.title: Flanagan expects response from 'out-muscled' Kildare
item.description: Brian Flanagan is confident that Kildare can bounce back from their heavy Allianz Football League Division 2 defeat to Meath.

item.title: Picky's return boosts Laois
item.description: Tommy Fitzgerald has welcomed Stephen 'Picky' Maher's return to the Laois hurling fold after a two-year absence.

item.title: Westmeath's John Joe marks 60 years of refereeing
item.description: John Joe Brady has been honoured for his incredible long service to refereeing in Westmeath.

item.title: Huge response to fundraiser for Tyrone mascot with rare brain tumour
item.description: There has been an incredible response to a GoFundMe appeal which was set up to support an eight-year-old Tyrone boy and his family.

item.title: 'It just shows you what football means'
item.description: Oisín McConville has paid tribute to London football manager Michael Maher who led his side to an Allianz League Division 4 victory over Waterford in Ruislip last Sunday, just 24 hours after attending his father's funeral in Wexford.

item.title: Gooch: Kobe will be a marked man
item.description: Colm Cooper has warned Mayo that Kobe McDonald will be a 'marked man' in this year's Championship.

item.title: O'Connor succeeds Chin as Wexford hurling captain
item.description: Jack O'Connor has been named as the new Wexford senior hurling captain.

item.title: Camogie Club Championship Team of the Year named
item.description: The Camogie Association have announced the AIB Camogie Club Championship Team of the Year.
